description: This file defines the TimesheetDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for data access operations related to timesheets, timesheet items, action logs, and employee reports. It includes CRUD methods, query builders, and report generation functions specific to timesheet management.

classes.name: TimesheetDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for Timesheet-related database operations, including CRUD, queries, and report generation for timesheets, timesheet items, and logs.

methods.name: getTimesheetById
methods.description: Retrieves a Timesheet entity by its ID.

methods.name: saveTimesheet
methods.description: Persists a Timesheet entity to the database.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByTimesheetIdAndTimesheetItemId
methods.description: Fetches a specific TimesheetItem by timesheet and item IDs.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsByTimesheetId
methods.description: Retrieves all TimesheetItems associated with a specific timesheet.

methods.name: saveTimesheetItem
methods.description: Persists a TimesheetItem entity.

methods.name: saveTimesheetActionLog
methods.description: Saves a TimesheetActionLog record.

methods.name: hasTimesheetForStartDate
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet exists for an employee on a specific start date.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogs
methods.description: Fetches action logs for a specific timesheet based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsPaginator
methods.description: Helper to paginate action logs for a timesheet.

methods.name: getTimesheetActionLogsCount
methods.description: Returns count of action logs for a timesheet.

methods.name: getTimesheetByStartAndEndDate
methods.description: Retrieves timesheets filtered by start and end dates.

methods.name: getTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Constructs a paginator for timesheets based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getTimesheetCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of timesheets matching filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteTimesheetRows
methods.description: Deletes specific timesheet rows based on provided project and activity IDs.

methods.name: saveAndUpdateTimesheetItems
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple TimesheetItems in batch.

methods.name: isDuplicateTimesheetItem
methods.description: Checks if a timesheet item with given project, activity, and timesheet IDs already exists.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetList
methods.description: Gets a list of timesheets for an employee with filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetPaginator
methods.description: Paginator for employee timesheets based on filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeTimesheetListCount
methods.description: Count of employee timesheets matching filters.

methods.name: getDefaultTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves the default timesheet for an employee within a date range.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Fetches timesheet items grouped for employee reports.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsCountForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Counts timesheet items for employee reports.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsPaginatorForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Helper for report-specific pagination of timesheet items.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemsForEmployeeReportQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a query wrapper for employee report data.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForEmployeeReport
methods.description: Calculates total minutes worked for an employee report.

methods.name: getTimesheetItemByProjectIdAndTimesheetIdAndActivityIdAndDate
methods.description: Retrieves a specific timesheet item matching project, timesheet, activity, and date.
